[[Category:Tranquility Cemetery, Tranquility, Ohio]]

== Biography ==
Samuel was born in 1851. He was the son of [[Glasgow-875|William Glasgow]] and [[McIntyre-4103|Marion McIntyre]].  He passed away in 1927.

== Research Notes ==
=== Current evidence assessment ===

==== Miami Valley biography ====
The memoir identifies S. S. Glasgow as born in Adams County on 4 June 1851, expressly a son of [[Glasgow-875|William B. Glasgow]]. His later Oxford life and family fit [[Glasgow-2043|Samuel Steele]]. The complete father identification is assessed at 99% confidence; this marks the existing father rather than attaching a new person. <ref name="Miami1919">John C. Hover et al., eds., ''Memoirs of the Miami Valley'' (Robert O. Law Company, 1919–1920), “S. S. Glasgow,” printed pp. 257–258; [https://digital.cincinnatilibrary.org/iiif/2/p16998coll15:18001/full/full/0/default.jpg original p. 257] and [https://digital.cincinnatilibrary.org/iiif/2/p16998coll15:18002/full/full/0/default.jpg original p. 258], Cincinnati & Hamilton County Public Library Digital Library; images inspected 22 October 2026. Published family biography, not a civil or parish register.</ref>

The source calls his mother Maria H. McIntire and dates her death to 1859. The attached [[McIntyre-4103|Marion McIntyre]] account instead gives 1855. These name and date differences remain unresolved; this source does not justify silently changing her identity or death date.
